prose: Tonight our analysis of the paradoxical trickster continues as we examine the second episode of Loki, Season 1. The mercurial Gemini symbolism starts getting quite thick, and you know there's a placenta casserole baking in here somewhere. Our piece-by-piece pace through this mystical symbolism will be a fun ride for anyone interested in the big questions of life, like free-will vs. determinism, timeline manipulation and legal system sorcery, the anima/animus, & the holy guardian angel.
